name: Black Box Ltd
title: Black Box Ltd - 500463 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,719 crore (+24% YoY) and order backlog of about US$950 million (+83%); FY27 guidance kept, with a 10% margin goal pushed to Q4 and beyond.

triggers.label: Backlog ~US$950M, up 83%
triggers.quote: taking our order backlog to a record ever of approximately US$950 million, up 83% year-on-year
triggers.highlight: order backlog to a record ever of approximately US$950 million, up 83%

triggers.label: Hiring ~2,000 professionals planned
triggers.quote: plans to onboard nearly 2,000 professionals, ensuring that we have the resources required

triggers.label: Margin goal slips into Q4
triggers.quote: we expect our -- as we move forward, our Q4 to be in that range or more
triggers.highlight: our Q4 to be in that range or more

triggers.label: Cable/fiber supply conditions improved
triggers.quote: supply chain conditions have also improved over the last quarter, particularly across cables and fiber
triggers.highlight: supply chain conditions have also improved over the last quarter

guidance.quote: order backlog, we should end on March 31, 2027 at US$ 1.3 billion to US$ 1.4 billion
Order bookings in the year, we should do between US$1.3 billion to US$1.4 billion
Revenue, we should do between INR7,800 crores to INR8,000 crores, which is a growth of 23% to 27%
EBITDA, we should do between INR725 crores to INR750 crores
EBITDA margins will range between 9.3% to 9.4%, which is again up by around 30 to 40 basis points
Profit after tax, we are expecting between INR300 crores to INR 325 crores
for FY27 and FY28, I'm expecting it to be in the range between 10% to 15%
our aspiration is to build Black Box into an INR18,000 crores or US$2 billion revenue company by FY30

red_flags.label: Cash conversion weak despite claims
red_flags.quote: our cash flow will be positive and then the cycle of the cash flow will automatically pick up

red_flags.label: Guidance corrections read out on call
red_flags.quote: (inadvertently stated - US$1.4 billion to US$1.5 billion: to be ignored)

red_flags.label: Product/TPS segment losses widening
red_flags.quote: our revenues have jumped up, but so have the EBIT losses

evasions.quote: right now, it looks like that from operation, our cash flow will be positive

evasions.topic: Order cancellation risk from hyperscaler capex
evasions.quote: So, can something dramatically change? No, I wouldn't be, wanting to predict that
